diameterInterpretation: Published radar-model equivalent diameter; original coordinates are not rescaled.
limitations: The archived 1998 model observations did not determine a unique spin pole. Later 2013 photometry supersedes its 14.83 h modeling period with 14.28 h. This view retains the historical geometry, fixed arbitrary display axes and illustrative lighting, not a current attitude. Radar reconstruction constrains broad shape but supplies no registered optical texture.
periodInterpretation: Historical 1998 radar-model fitting period, 14.83 ± 0.15 h; not propagated.
orientationQualification: The archived 1998 radar reconstruction has no determined inertial spin pole. Use the existing fixed arbitrary display frame; optional directional lighting is illustrative. The historical modeling period and newer photometric period are recorded as information only, and neither is propagated into a current attitude.
updatedResearch: Warner (2014), Minor Planet Bulletin 41(2), 113–124; 2013 photometry gives 14.28 ± 0.01 h. Sharkey et al. (2016), DPS 48 abstract 326.02, reports that new radar data reject the old 14.83 h model period; the updated numeric mesh/pole have not been acquired.
